assumptions.text: 30% of registered users are daily active

options.description: Single managed PostgreSQL instance, smallest tier, daily backup with PITR
trade_offs: Costs GBP 15/month more than a file-based database on the same host

options.description: File-based database on a persistent volume
options.reason: No managed point-in-time recovery; restore is manual and untested. A two-person team will not test it. Revisit if a tested restore procedure exists and is exercised quarterly.

options.description: Managed PostgreSQL with a managed cache in front
options.reason: At 0.28 peak RPS there is no measured read pressure to relieve. Revisit when a single query exceeds 10 requests/second at over 50 ms.
trade_offs: Would relieve read pressure that does not exist
